# Showcase typefaces

These unmodified fonts are bundled for offline use under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. Each family includes its upstream OFL.txt with copyright and reserved font names. Local font.ttf is the upstream file listed below, renamed without modifying its contents.

| Family | Upstream file | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Cinzel Decorative | `CinzelDecorative-Regular.ttf` | [Google Fonts](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/cinzeldecorative) |
| MedievalSharp | `MedievalSharp.ttf` | [Google Fonts](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/medievalsharp) |
| Uncial Antiqua | `UncialAntiqua-Regular.ttf` | [Google Fonts](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/uncialantiqua) |
| Pirata One | `PirataOne-Regular.ttf` | [Google Fonts](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/pirataone) |
| Almendra | `Almendra-Regular.ttf` | [Google Fonts](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/almendra) |
| IM Fell English | `IMFeENrm28P.ttf` | [Google Fonts](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/imfellenglish) |
| Lato | `Lato-Regular.ttf` | [Google Fonts](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/lato) |
| Lora | `Lora[wght].ttf` | [Google Fonts](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/lora) |
| Open Sans | `OpenSans[wdth,wght].ttf` | [Google Fonts](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/opensans) |
